title: Start here: current Photo Survey World state
summary: Photo Survey World dev21 is the current Library head. It reconstructs one world from independent photo observations and keeps model/provider output subordinate to explicit survey evidence and Maths-backed geometry.

current_baseline.runtime: Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version

invariants: One world, multiple independent camera observations; never pixel-stitch photographs into panorama truth.
Maths owns reusable mathematics; Photo World owns survey meaning.
Foreign providers submit evidence and cannot mutate SurveyWorld.
Unknown geometry remains unknown rather than being filled with plausible dimensions.

provenance.claim: Current Photo Survey World implementation and dev21 scope.
